title: Crane symbols match Sheehan's drawings
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: what he had draw is very close to what I seen

plain: In 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, a man named Randy Anderson says he saw symbols that closely match drawings made by a man named Dan Sheehan. Anderson tells it as something he saw himself, and in his words, "what he had draw is very close to what I seen." He tells it because, if true, two separate people would have recorded the same strange markings, which he links to technology he believes is not human.
